body: I think drawFocusIfNeeded, scrollPathIntoView and HitRegion stuff should belong in a sub-interface. Something like CanvasUserInterfaceMethods

I think it is somewhat weird that some of these have a "Methods" suffix while others do not. Especially since they might get properties on them going forward too. I would prefer if it we did not do that, even though this is just mixin naming.

Naive question: what is the purpose of "Exposed=..." when we have the NoInterfaceObject attribute? Can't we just let the concrete interfaces that implement this decide where they get exposed? I know this not something new in this change (other interfaces have this attribute combo), so I am not really challenging this, just trying to understand. IMHO there is not practical use for this, and it creates a dimension of opportunities for the spec to break consistency with itself.
I can follow up with a global cleanup if @annevk or @domenic agree this is superfluous.
Unfortunately `implements` does not imply `[Exposed]` as I understand things. Perhaps @heycam can make this simpler one day, but I believe this is required for the moment.
